- Initial release of concur-fpx for shell-based, read-only access to SAP Concur expense data via the user's signed-in Concur browser session with fpx CLI.
- Supports listing expense reports, viewing line item details (vendor, type, amounts, receipts, exceptions), and querying available (unsubmitted) expenses.
- Uses the fpx CLI to relay GraphQL API calls through an open, authenticated Concur web tab; no direct API key or OAuth setup required.
- Setup instructions provided for pairing the skill with the appropriate browser and ContextMint Bridge extension.
- Includes `scripts/concur-gql` for running predefined GraphQL queries, with ready-to-use jq recipes and troubleshooting guidance.
